name: Two-Factor Authentication
description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/2fa/status to check 2FA status
2. 2FA Handler: Checks if user has 2FA enabled and returns setup information if not (routes/2fa.ts)
3. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/2fa/setup with password, setup token, and initial TOTP token
4. 2FA Handler: Validates password and setup token, verifies initial TOTP token (routes/2fa.ts)
5. 2FA Handler: Updates user record with TOTP secret (routes/2fa.ts)
6. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/2fa/verify with temp token and TOTP token
7. 2FA Handler: Verifies TOTP token against user's secret (routes/2fa.ts)
8. 2FA Handler: Returns final JWT token for authenticated session (routes/2fa.ts)
